text: Filed upstream 2026-10-09 as https://github.com/scala-js/scala-js/issues/5436, after re-running the standalone repro (fullLinkJS, fastLinkJS and optimizer-off all hang; calls=0) and confirming 1.22.0 is the latest release and that SJSGen.genIsInstanceOfClass on upstream main still folds to false. The core workaround stays until a fixed release is adopted.
